protocol_name: Module 3: load capsules, lysis, washes, reverse transcription, wash, release - module3_v1

events.narration: Load the capsule suspension into the trap through the pre-filter. Capsules settle on the retention gap and the carrier leaves through the wash waste; the load is one chamber volume.

Lyse the cells in the capsules: push lysis buffer through the bed to its own dedicated waste line, which never meets the other waste. 5 fills of one chamber volume each, so the bed is fully exchanged.
Lysis dwell with every port capped, at room temperature, so the lysis buffer reaches the cells inside the capsules.
Wash out the lysis buffer through the retention gap to the wash waste: 3 rounds of 5 fills of one chamber volume each, since carryover would inhibit the next step.

Fill the trap with the reverse-transcription mix, which carries a plain poly(dT) primer: no barcode and no UMI are added here, because the cells already carry their per-lane barcode from module 1. One chamber volume, so the bed is covered and no more is spent.

Reverse transcription: one isothermal hold in the trap, in the heated zone under the chamber, with every port capped. The only thermal step on this chip; the chamber is held between 4 and 50 C by its thermal zone.
Wash the reverse-transcription mix out through the retention gap to the wash waste, leaving cDNA inside the capsules: 3 rounds of 5 fills of one chamber volume each.
Back-flush the trap through backflush_in: liquid pushed up through the retention gap lifts the capsules off it and sweeps them towards the capsule outlet.
Release the capsules to module 4 as one counted suspension through to_split_tree. 2 chamber volumes of buffer carry the bed out; module 4 then splits it into the sublibraries and adds the index.
